note: Public Ed25519 release keys. See docs/release-signing.md for the rotation procedure. Both slots are 'reserved': the bootstrap accepts no signed release until the first signing ceremony replaces slot one with the key held in the protected release environment.

states.active: signs new releases and verifies them
states.retiring: no longer signs; still verifies, so releases signed before the rotation keep installing
states.reserved: a published slot with no live key behind it; never verifies anything

keys.comment: slot one: replaced by the launch signing key at the first ceremony
slot two: the successor, published one bootstrap version before it starts signing
